d:
Ranchi sadar aspatal ki chaunkane vali hakikat, top 10 hospital men shamil, lekin aag se bachav ke intjam nahin
Aspatal ko marijon ke lie sabse surakshit jaghon men hona chahie, kyonki yahan jo bhi marij ilaj ke lie bharti hote hain, vah chalne phirne men asmarth hote hain aur aapat sthiti men vah apni jan bachane ke lie bhag bhi nahin sakte, lekin aapko yah jankar hairani hogi ki sarkar ke nak ke niche ranchi ke sadar aspatal men aapat sthiti men aag jaisi ghatna hone par bachav ki vyavastha savalon ke ghere men hai.
